components.caption: The whole app on a phone: header, sleep graph card, the two summary cards, wellness and heart rate in one scrolling column.
The sleep bar — a bespoke Canvas chart with per-stage gradients. Its correctness is only visible as pixels.
A full week of nights in the custom time-graph layout, inside its card chrome.
The bare custom Layout without card chrome — the measure/place algorithm that decides where each bar starts.
The heart-rate trace: a smoothed Path with a translucent range band behind it.
Awake / REM / Light / Deep as swatches — the four colours every chart above is built from.
Legend mapping each sleep stage to its colour token.
Average time asleep summary card.
Average time in bed summary card.
Heart-rate summary card at the default 65 bpm.
Wellness summary card on the default sample values.
One wellness bubble on its own — title, count and metric inside a circle.
The border-coloured card shell every summary card is built on.
Icon over two lines of text, stacked.
The heading style shared by every card.
Screen header — menu button and title over the moving-stripes background.
The Day/Week/Month/6M/1Y scrollable tab row, selected on Week.
The loading indicator's fading-circle animation, captured as a still frame.
Highest emphasis; the primary action; the disabled state folds in as an @OverrideVariant (enabled = false).
Secondary, still prominent.
Medium emphasis on a busy surface.
Outlined alternative needing separation.
Lowest emphasis; inline actions.
A card with named PreviewSlot regions a structured-screen builder fills.
Checked; the unchecked state folds in as an @OverrideVariant (checked = false).
On; the off state folds in as an @OverrideVariant (checked = false).
Selected; the unselected state folds in as an @OverrideVariant (selected = false).
Selected; the unselected state folds in as an @OverrideVariant (selected = false).
Single-choice toggle: selected + unselected segments.
Full-screen layout with the OS status bar — TopAppBar, a list, and a FAB, captured with showSystemUi on a phone.
maxLines=2 + ellipsis overflow — exercises the textOverflow product.
Generic serif family (Noto Serif) — pins the Wasm tier’s font interception.
Generic monospace family (Droid Sans Mono) — pins the Wasm tier’s font interception.
